description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You Break the Anchor against a Named target.

Break the Anchor can jump from its target to a second Named target within reach, at reduced effect.

The break jumps to one other Named creature within reach of the first. It suffers your Ward's Break the Anchor effect at half value — half the damage, half the duration, one step less severe where the effect has steps — with no new roll on your part. It cannot jump again from there.

cinderfall.incomplete: Extends 'Break the Anchor,' whose actual per-Ward implementation (ash-iron-lantern-spell, binding-chain-spell, static-glass-mirror-spell, warded-blade-spell) all correctly ship rules: [] per real precedent (Thunderous Strike/Warding Aggression, both rules: []) -- the numbers live in system.damage, not system.rules, so there is no rule-element hook on any of the four Ward cards to relay at half value in the first place, and the effect varies per Ward besides.
